Accessibility Clinic Renovation Report

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited zone property schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 5 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, at least 1 IfcSlab entity, and at least 1 IfcRoof entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: RECEPTION, WAITING, CONSULT, TREATMENT, WC-ACC.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [13.0, 7.0, 3.2].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area, AccessibilityCritical.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 5 data rows in this order: C01 RECEPTION 12.0 Yes, C02 WAITING 15.0 Yes, C03 CONSULT 12.0 No, C04 TREATMENT 24.0 No, C05 WC-ACC 16.0 Yes, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10.
11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, ACCESSIBILITY CLINIC RENOVATION REPORT, RECEPTION, WAITING, CONSULT, WC-ACC.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
